fieldNotes.location: Roster address (1500 N Cockrell Hill Rd) was WRONG. Correct address is 1141 Regal Row, Dallas TX 75247 (PotatoPro + Waze + Yellowpages confirm). Building positively identified by red Frito-Lay wall sign visible in 2024/2025 Street View on the east building face.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire property enclosed by chain-link / iron fence; sliding gates control vehicle access at the east office/parking entrance and the dock-yard entrance. No open uncontrolled driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at any gate in Street View or satellite. Older urban plant with self-managed sliding gates.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack -> remote / call-box / badge check-in implied.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur runs along the south/southwest side of the building; covered hopper / tank rail cars visible parked against the building in 2019 Street View (rail-served snack manufacturing — receives bulk grain/corn).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors with trailers backed in visible along the east and north building faces; band 10-25 estimated, exact count obscured by adjacent buildings and fence — low confidence.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Constrained urban site hemmed by neighboring industrial buildings on the south and west; narrow streets and short driveways leave little truck stacking room before gates.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single Frito-Lay building. Adjacent large warehouses belong to other companies, not Frito-Lay.
fieldNotes.siteArea: ~6 acres for the fenced property derived from the perimeter box; building footprint alone ~4.2 acres.
